### Biography

### Predrag Milutinovic, Dipl.Ing.Arch

![](https://www.predragmilutinovic.com/sr/images/predrag-milutinovic-biography.jpg)

Born in Ivanjica in 1975. He graduated from the Faculty of Architecture, University of Belgrade, in 2002; He is continuously engaged in architectural design. He is the author of many public buildings, individual, residential and collective housing facilities, industrial facilities, facilities for special purposes, interiors of public, commercial and residential buildings. He has received significant awards for his projects. He is a participant of many public and open call competitions, where he achieved outstanding results.


In addition to design, he manages development investment processes, management and coordination of design and construction of large buildings (Design management/Project Managment), consulting services in the hotel industry, and specialized facilities. Within "Delta Holding" company he was a Director of the architecture and design management in development and project management.

**MOST IMPORTANT COMPLETED FACILITIES:**

Center "Sun", Home for children with disabilities, Bezanijska kosa, Belgrade (2012.); Commerce and Business Center "Fortuna", Arandjelovac (2012.); Car Salon “BMW i MINI”, Cukarica Belgrade (2008.) ; Center for sport, rehabilitation and recreation for paralympians ISKRA Kragujevac (2016); “BMW” Autogarant Motors, Cacak (2010.); “BMW” Stefanovic, Mladenovac (2010.); “BMW” Cvetni Trg (2007.); “HONDA” centar, Belgrade (2006.); “BMW” Mitic, Nis (2013.); Auto Centar “MAZDA” Nikolic, Kragujevac (2015.); Vila “Maksic”, Belgrade (2012.); Reconstruction and extension of “Domain de Ranguin”villa, Cannes, France (2004.); Villa “M” Belgrade (2011.); Commercial and residential building “Generali” Kragujevac (2009); "Universal Bank", Knez Mihailova, Belgrade (2007); HOTEL IN, Belgrade (2013); Interior "Sani Optik", Terazije, Belgrade (2014); Villa "SJ", Beogradskih bataljona, Belgrade (2014); The interior of the office building "Magna Pharmacy", Belgrade (2015); Center for sport, recreation and rehabilitation, "Paralympic Center", Kragujevac (2015); The interior of the office building "Sani Group", Sabac (2015).


**THE MOST SIGNIFICANT AWARDS:**

The "City of Belgrade" award for best completed work in architecture and urban planning (2012);

The “NEWS” company award for best completed architectural work (2012);

"Saint Gobain Rigips" company’s First prize for the most beautiful interior in Serbia and Montenegro (2009);

Special recognition of “DaNS” for architectural completion (2010);

10 best architectural achievements in 2012; jury of NIN.
